title: Luka sings 'Sweet Dreams' | Blind Audition | The Voice van Vlaanderen | VTM
description: Sixteen -year -old Luka is one of the youngest candidates in the Voice. She gives her own twist to 'Sweet Dreams' by Marilyn Manson', one that you will not soon forget!  // Subscribe // Don't forget to subscribe to the YouTube channel of 'The Voice van Vlaanderen' and view the new performances first: http://www.youtube.com/c/thevoicevanvlaanderen?sub_ConFirMATION=1  // Website // For more information and the full delivery to our website: http://thevoice.vtm.be/  // social media // Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/thevoicevanvlaanderen Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/vtmthevoice  // about the show // A unique and pure voice that you blow over, that's what it's all about in The Voice of Flanders. Koen Wauters, Natalie and Bart Peeters are again present as a coach and again get the company of Alex Callier. They all have a goal in mind: after six Blind Auditions, they each select 12 talents for their team, which they guide for weeks on the basis of their own experience in their early music career.
